scope: Additive Life Gem L1-18 Grand Warden passive HP aura and 2026 balance audit, excluding Tournament Mode, Totems and siege machines.
game_version: Official January, February and April 2026 changes; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Life Gem is Common passive Grand Warden Equipment; nearby units gain extra HP.
Its secondary effects increase Warden DPS and HP.
sources.limitations: No radius, entity-class membership, HP formula, cap or gain/loss timing is specified.

sources.title: Hero Equipment Balance Changes!
facts: Supercell stated the Life Gem buff aimed to make it useful for armies with bigger troops and more housing space.
sources.limitations: Does not supply level values or a housing-based HP formula.

sources.title: January Balance Changes!
facts: L1-7 Extra HP rose by 20-29 percent and Extra HP Cap by 14-26 percent.
L1-18 Warden HP rose by 2.79-3.14 percent and DPS by 2.17-5.56 percent.
sources.limitations: The published ranges do not map an exact old/new value to each level or specify rounding. The frozen raw effect and Warden bonus rows cannot be treated as confirmed current values.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
facts: Life Gem aura no longer affects Totems.
sources.limitations: Totem Spell completion is outside this goal; this exclusion does not define all other target classes.

sources.title: THE SOUND OF CLASH UPDATE
facts: Siege machines are immune to Life Gem effects.
sources.limitations: Siege machine integration is excluded from the current goal.

sources.title: Life Gem — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated page confirms L1-18, upgrade costs and passive nearby-friendly-unit HP description.
Its listed Warden HP 170-500 and DPS 11-75 match frozen raw fields.
sources.limitations: The page does not show Extra HP or cap, and its unchanged Warden HP/DPS series conflicts with the official January 2026 increase if presented as post-change values.

sources.title: Pinned Life Gem Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned payload carries L1-18 hpIncreasePercent 50-120 percent, maxHpIncrease 640-1200, Warden hitpointIncrease 170-500 and dpsIncrease 11-75.
sources.limitations: Official January 2026 changes make at least L1-7 aura values and L1-18 Warden bonuses historical. The payload has no geometry, HP application or tick-order contract.

observations.note: Pinned numbers remain traceable source fields; no post-January current effect values are inferred from aggregate percentage ranges.

derivations.result: Retain frozen raw and dated cost fields as catalogue history; mark current bonus values unverified
derivations.method: Compare the official January 2026 level ranges against pinned level fields and dated secondary rows without calculating missing per-level replacements.

derivations.result: Record explicit Totem and siege exclusions
derivations.method: Use February and April 2026 official release notes; keep excluded content outside this goal.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the January 2026 percent range uniformly to every affected level
rejected_inferences.reason: Supercell gives aggregate min/max changes, not each old/new pair or rounding rule.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use raw L1-7 extra HP, cap and L1-18 Warden bonuses as current
rejected_inferences.reason: The official January 2026 change supersedes those raw fields; the dated secondary table repeats the old Warden series.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat housing space as an HP multiplier
rejected_inferences.reason: The January 2025 design note discusses larger troop use but gives no formula.

rejected_inferences.rule: Grant current HP immediately on aura entry or preserve it after exit
rejected_inferences.reason: Sources do not define current-HP conversion, cap, clipping, re-entry or death boundaries.

rejected_inferences.rule: Reuse Eternal Tome aura radius and entity eligibility
rejected_inferences.reason: Shared Grand Warden visuals do not prove identical geometry or target-class filters.

items: exact post-January L1-7 extra HP and cap and L1-18 Warden HP/DPS values
aura center, radius, boundary and target eligibility beyond Totem/siege exclusions
maximum HP versus current HP conversion, cap, heal, exit and re-entry behavior
stacking with Apprentice Warden, other Equipment, Pets and revival
same-tick movement, aura update, healing, damage and death order
Viewer aura overlay, snapshot, replay and RL state

conclusion: Life Gem L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official 2026 balance changes supersede frozen raw bonus values without complete per-level replacements; HP aura geometry and current-HP/tick behavior remain unresolved.
